page.layout: One printed page: title page, all lines centred inside an ornamental woodcut border. No running head, page number, catchword or signature.
page.notes: The date line is printed in the reversed-C form "cIↄ Iↄ CVII", converted to MDCVII per the numeral rule. The sign between "est explicatio." and "BASILEAE" is an ornamental fleuron and is not transcribed. The library stamp at the foot and the faint show-through of the reverse page at the right edge are omitted. The "SYNTAGMA" line is set in spaced capitals, and "METHODO" in small capitals, both rendered as plain caps.
